judged_text: The per-destination loop issues a `prisma.credential.findUnique` per destination inside the iteration (N+1), and handleCancelBooking.ts repeats the same per-reference DB fetch inside its loop. A collective booking with many hosts (or a cancellation touching many references) issues one sequential DB round-trip per destination instead of one batched `findMany({ id: { in: [...] } })`, adding latency to the booking hot path linear in host count.

adjudication.rationale: The diff does introduce per-item DB lookups inside newly added loops. In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, the new `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` branch calls `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: destination.credentialId } })` when the credential isn’t in `this.calendarCredentials`, which can become N sequential queries for N destinations. Similarly, in `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts`, the new `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)` loop performs `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId } })` when the user credential isn’t found, again potentially N queries for N references. This is a concrete, diff-grounded performance/latency issue (hot path) rather than a functional correctness bug.
